motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing and Electing Officers to Serve in the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City
motions.motion: Board Member Wood moved to elect Melissa Clark as the Vice Chairperson for the Redevelopment Agency . Board Member Whiting seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing Abby Ivory as Executive Director of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City Director of Legislative and Strategic Affairs Evan Berrett explained that the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain has historically appointed an Executive Director to oversee the day -to-day operations , represent the Agency to taxing entities as needed, and provide oversight and reporting to ongoing CRA project areas. Mr. Berrett noted that this role has typically been filled by the Eagle Mountain City Economic Development Director. Due to somewhat recent organizational changes, and the hiring of a new Economic Development Director for Eagle Mountain City, Abby Ivory, a new appoi ntment is recommended.
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Appointing Abby Ivory as Executive Director of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City . Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
